method.time: UTC. Git checkpoint times date publication of a continuation, not Finish execution. Run updated_at is an observation of workflow completion, not a precise output-publication timestamp. Durations use explicit pairs only; step wall intervals are not model-active time.
method.actions_mapping: Each run retains id, attempt, job id and zero-based JSON pointers. Workflow checkout maps session upload immediately before Pack to diagnostic stream, after Pack to results; epilogue first download to results and second to baseline. This mapping is source-based, not historical artifact-content inspection.
